note: Declared hosts the catalogue projects per-node likelihood throughput onto (build_catalogue.py, projected_node_throughput). Values from sinfo on RAL, 2026-10-25. A projection is basis projected: workers per node capped by cores and by memory, times the declared parallel efficiency, over the measured per-call time. It is not a measurement; phase 4 of the likelihood-lifecycle epic measures the parallel efficiency.

ral_cpu_node.label: RAL ral node (smallest)
ral_cpu_node.source: sinfo 2026-10-25: ral nodes have 236-252 cores and 921-976 GB; the smallest is declared

not_modelled: The sampler's batch ceiling: Nautilus evaluates at most n_batch points in parallel per batch, so a node cannot use more workers than n_batch. Shared memory bandwidth and caches between workers are also not modelled; the declared parallel efficiency stands in for them.
